case_number: 2025 INSC 437; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (ARISING OUT OF SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NO. 9586 OF 2024)
summary: Challenge to blanket annulment of 2016 WBSSC recruitment process for teaching and non-teaching posts; CBI investigation initiated after allegations of rank-jumping, illegal appointments, non-publication of results, and destruction of OMR sheets; WBSSC admitted irregularities; failure to preserve OMRs despite rules; natural justice violation claims; distinction between tainted and clean selectees; scope of judicial interference in recruitment annulment; validity of OMR destruction; High Court's wholesale quashing set aside in part.
legal_provisions_cited: West Bengal School Service Commission Act, 1997
West Bengal Board of Secondary Education Act, 1963
West Bengal School Service Commission (Selection for Appointment to the posts of Teachers for Classes IX and X) Rules, 2016
West Bengal School Service Commission (Selection for Appointment to the posts of Teachers for Classes XI and XII) Rules, 2016
West Bengal School Service Commission (Selection of Persons for Appointment to the Post of Non-Teaching Staff) Rules, 2009
Rule 17, Classes IX-X and XI-XII Rules
Rule 21, Classes IX-X and XI-XII Rules
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; impugned judgment modifying scope of annulment; appointments of unproven guilty selectees not automatically invalidated; direction for fresh inquiry against specifically accused; CBI findings to be considered; proportionality principle applied; complete set-aside of selection process set aside.
